name: Your Next Stop Is
source:
Berliana is a private-sector employee working in the Sudirman office district who commutes daily between Bekasi and Jakarta. One day, a massive layoff occurs due to economic conditions; on her final day at the office, while traveling back to Bekasi Station, she falls asleep and enters a dream world where she encounters the gijinka of the stations she frequently passes. Within this dream, she interacts with them while navigating the process of finding a new job. What kind of job does Berliana ultimately secure following these encounters with the station gijinka?

[Translated from [url=https://rekkatsu.itch.io/yournextstopis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
贝莉安娜是在苏迪曼办公区工作的私企职员，每天往返于勿加泗与雅加达之间通勤。某天，受经济形势影响，公司爆发了大规模裁员；在办公室的最后一天，她在乘车返回勿加泗站的途中沉沉睡去，进入了一个梦境世界，并在那里邂逅了自己日常途经各座车站的拟人化角色。在这场梦境中，她一边与车站拟人角色们交流互动，一边摸索寻找新工作的方向。经历这些奇妙邂逅之后，贝莉安娜最终会找到一份怎样的工作呢？
